title: Potential Starting Pitchers for Guardians and Rays in Game 4 of 2026 ALCS
text:
The Cleveland Guardians have regained the lead in the 2026 American League Championship Series. The Guardians beat the Tampa Bay Rays 3-2 in Game 3 of the ALCS
Oct 15, 2026; Cleveland, Ohio, USA; Cleveland Guardians manager Stephen Vogt gives the ball to pitcher Cade Smith during the eighth inning against the Tampa Bay Rays in game three of the ALCS for the 2026 MLB playoffs at Progressive Field.
Mandatory Credit: Ken Blaze-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters ConnectGame 3 of the ALCS. Right-hander Gavin Williams tossed five innings for Cleveland on Thursday, allowing just two hits and two runs while striking out nine. Offensively, Guardians outfielder Petey Halpin's two-run shot in the fifth inning proved to be the difference in Game 3. And now, Cleveland heads into Game 4 with a 2-1 series lead.
Oct 7, 2026; Bronx, New York, USA; Tampa Bay Rays pitcher Nick Martinez throws during the first inning against the New York Yankees in game three of the ALDS for the 2026 MLB playoffs at Yankee Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Brad Penner-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect If Game 4 of the ALCS is played on Friday, right-hander Nick Martinez is the most likely candidate to start for Tampa Bay.
The 36-year-old startedand was forced to exit the game after being struck by a line drive. That means the 2026 All-Star should be well-rested ahead of his next outing. If Friday's game is pushed back to Saturday due to weather concerns, the Rays could have an interesting decision to make. Right-hander Drew Rasmussen startedfor Tampa Bay on Oct. 12.
So, Saturday would be the 31-year-old's turn to start on four days' rest. As long as Game 4 is played as scheduled, though, Rasmussen would likely be the Rays' top option to start Game 5 of the ALCS. Oct 7, 2026; Chicago, Illinois, USA; Cleveland Guardians pitcher Daniel Espino throws a pitch during the first inning against the Chicago White Sox in game three of the ALDS for the 2026 MLB playoffs at Rate Field.
Mandatory Credit: Matt Marton-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect The Guardians haven't officially announced a starter for Game 4 yet, but they're expected to go with a bullpen game. Cleveland used right-handerand could do so again on Friday. Guardians pitchers Tanner Bibee, Joey Cantillo, and Slade Cecconi could also appear early in Game 4.could turn to ALCS Game 1 starter Foster Griffin if Game 4 is postponed until Saturday.
But if Game 4 is played on Friday, Griffin and Rasmussen might be set for a rematch as the ALCS Game 5 starters. Justin Binkowski is a lifelong baseball fan returning to cover the sport he loves after spending nearly a decade writing about video games. Before his time as managing editor at Dot Esports, Binkowski attended King's College in Wilkes-Barre, PA, where he was also a relief pitcher on the school's baseball team.
While in college, Binkowski was a media relations intern for the Scranton/Wilkes-Barre RailRiders during the 2014 season.
